# fickle

> liable to sudden unpredictable change, esp.

> quick to change one's opinion or allegiance


## Example

- *in affections or attachments. She was so fickle in her politics, it was hard to pinpoint her beliefs; one week she would embrace a side, and the next week she would denounce it.*
